$comment: Phase 0.2 Medium-tier scoring rubric. Timestamped at commit; no post-hoc edits per spec v16 §0.0a. Hybrid shape per ADR-0016: programmatic scoring for embedder; Perplexity-gold scoring for planner and coder. Elimination phase (Fast-tier-style hard checks) runs before scoring and is unchanged from ADR-0007.

elimination_phase.$comment: Runs before scoring. Same shape as Fast-tier ADR-0007 rubric; failures never reach scoring phase.

embedder.ground_truth_source: bench/tasks/embedder-medium-qrels.json (or inline #/qrels in embedder-medium task file)

planner.gold_source: bench/gold/planner-medium/<task-id>.md (Perplexity-Max reference plans, frozen at task-set commit)
planner.scoring_authority: Perplexity Max (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Perplexity Computer)
planner.scoring_protocol: local-llm-bench skill canonical scoring protocol: dump stripped cell outputs, paste to Perplexity Max with gold reference, receive numeric scores per task, record via --record-scores

coder.gold_source: bench/gold/coder-medium/<task-id>.md (Perplexity-Max reference tool-call transcripts + expected diffs, frozen at task-set commit)
coder.scoring_authority: Perplexity Max (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Perplexity Computer)

tiebreak.secondary: wall-time median across task set (lower wins) — applies only when top two cells are within 3 quality points of each other
tiebreak.reference: local-llm-bench skill principle 1 (quality-first) and tiebreak convention

post_hoc_edit_policy.note: Any change to this file after the first Medium-tier scored run requires a superseding ADR. Any change to bench/tasks/embedder-medium-qrels.json, bench/tasks/{embedder,planner,coder}-medium.json, or files under bench/gold/** requires either a superseding ADR or a re-authored versioned task-set file.
